outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Newcastle United FC 0.50 vs Arsenal FC 1.33, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: Newcastle United FC at home: 1W-2D-2L, 6 scored and 7 conceded in 5 games.
Arsenal FC away: 4W-0D-1L, 5 scored and 3 conceded in 5 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.53 goals per game, away teams 1.20.
Recent league form (newest first): Newcastle United FC DLWLL, Arsenal FC WWWWW (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: Newcastle United FC has 5 home games and Arsenal FC 5 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
